# Vendored source

`UxPlay/` is an unmodified source snapshot of [FDH2/UxPlay v1.73.6](https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay/tree/21eef8df25d91e12635c36d8176ad192725baca2).

Commit: `21eef8df25d91e12635c36d8176ad192725baca2`.
License: GPL-3.0-or-later, with component notices retained in the snapshot.

Git metadata is intentionally omitted. `Scripts/build.sh` applies Airplayer's integration changes to a disposable build copy, never to these files.
